items.title: Microsoft Unveils Surface Pro 12-inch and Laptop 13-inch with AI Boost
items.summary: Discover the latest innovations as Microsoft unveils the new Surface Pro 12-inch and Laptop 13-inch, featuring AI Boost technology for enhanced performance and productivity. Explore the cutting-edge features that redefine versatility in the world of computing.
items.whyItMatters: Context rather than a task. Useful for deciding what to commit to next quarter and what to ignore.
actions: Background reading — no action needed today, but worth knowing.

items.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
items.summary: Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your inbox to buying new shoes.
items.whyItMatters: This is back-office time. Anything here competes directly with hours you are personally spending on admin.
actions: Worth an hour to set up if you are still coordinating bookings by email.
